title: Colony Mix Assay
author: Isaac Núñez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jsucnew

steps.title: Grow transformed TOP10 cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate TOP10 E.coli cells containing each vector (e.g., CyOFP, mBeRFP, sfGFP) into 14 ml round‑bottom tubes with 1–5 ml LB medium plus the appropriate antibiotics and grow overnight with agitation at 37 °C.

steps.title: Mix cultures proportionally
steps.instruction: Combine the overnight cultures in equal volumes (e.g., 100 µl of each) to create a mixed suspension. Skip this step if only a single culture is to be used (proceed directly to the dilution step).

steps.title: Perform three consecutive dilutions
steps.instruction: Make three serial 1:100 dilutions of the pure or mixed culture using LB as diluent:

substeps.instruction: 1) First dilution: 10² dilution (1:100) – add 1 part culture to 99 parts LB.
2) Second dilution: 10⁴ dilution (1:100) – take 1 part of the first dilution and add 99 parts LB.
3) Third dilution: 10⁶ dilution (1:100) – take 1 part of the second dilution and add 99 parts LB.

steps.title: Spread diluted culture on agar
steps.instruction: Plate 50 µl of the final (third) dilution onto an LB agar plate containing the appropriate antibiotic(s) (e.g., Kanamycin).

substeps.instruction: Distribute the 50 µl evenly using glass beads, an L‑shaped spreader, or another spreading method.
Seal the plate with parafilm to prevent dehydration and to allow long‑term storage (weeks).
If performing timelapse imaging, do NOT seal the plate to avoid lid condensation.

steps.title: Optional 8‑hour 37 °C pre‑incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the seeded plate at 37 °C for the first 8 hours to accelerate colony appearance (this step is optional).

steps.title: Incubate plates to develop colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at the desired temperature (room temperature or 37 °C) for 1–4 days. For fastest growth, keep at 37 °C for 1–2 days to reach maximum colony size; at room temperature growth will take roughly twice as long.
